text_draft: Kò tọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀! A máa ń ṣe àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ síi papọ̀, okay?
switch_points: Kò tọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀! A máa ń ṣe àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ síi papọ̀, [[okay]]?
register_note: Keep the tone gentle and reassuring — no hint of disappointment — so the child feels safe to keep trying.

function_reminder: Reassure the child they're staying at paragraph level.
text_draft: Ó dára, a ó máa ṣiṣẹ pẹ̀lú paragraph. O ń ṣe dáadáa!
switch_points: Ó dára, a ó máa ṣiṣẹ pẹ̀lú [[paragraph]]. O ń ṣe dáadáa!
register_note: Keep the tone warm and encouraging — celebrate effort, not failure, so the child feels safe staying at this level.

function_reminder: Gently explain the child will practice letter/syllable items for a bit.
text_draft: Ó dára, ẹ jẹ́ ká ṣe àtúnyẹ̀wò lẹ́tà díẹ̀ papọ̀. Ready? Jẹ́ kí a bẹ̀rẹ̀!
switch_points: Ó dára, ẹ jẹ́ ká ṣe àtúnyẹ̀wò lẹ́tà díẹ̀ papọ̀. [[Ready?]] Jẹ́ kí a bẹ̀rẹ̀!
register_note: Use an upbeat, reassuring tone — frame the level drop as a fun new game, not a setback, so the child feels encouraged rather than discouraged.

function_reminder: Explain that this first session is about finding the right starting level.
text_draft: Ẹ káàbọ̀! Ní ìtẹ̀jáde àkọ́kọ́ yìí, a ó wá ìpele tó dára jù fún ọ.
switch_points: Ẹ káàbọ̀! Ní ìtẹ̀jáde àkọ́kọ́ yìí, a ó wá [[level]] tó dára jù fún ọ.
register_note: Warm and welcoming, like a friendly teacher greeting a child on their very first day — gentle, unhurried, and reassuring.

function_reminder: Encourage a child who seems to be losing focus or getting tired.
text_draft: Ẹ̀yẹ kékeré, o ṣe dára! Keep going, a fẹ́rẹ̀ parí!
switch_points: Ẹ̀yẹ kékeré, o ṣe dára! [[Keep going]], a fẹ́rẹ̀ parí!
register_note: Warm and gently energising — like a kind teacher leaning in with a whispered cheer to help a tired child push through the last stretch.

function_reminder: Reassure a child who seems frustrated after a few misses in a row.
text_draft: Ẹ má worry, ọmọ mi! Ìdánwò ni — ìwọ ń ṣe dáadáa.
switch_points: [[Ẹ má worry]], ọmọ mi! Ìdánwò ni — ìwọ ń ṣe dáadáa.
register_note: Warm and soothing, like a kind teacher leaning in close; avoids any tone of evaluation or pressure so the child feels safe to keep trying.

function_reminder: Reassure a shy or nervous-sounding child before they begin.
text_draft: Ẹ̀rù má bà ọ, ọmọ mi. Ìwọ lè ṣe é — no worries rárá!
switch_points: Ẹ̀rù má bà ọ, ọmọ mi. Ìwọ lè ṣe é — [[no worries]] rárá!
register_note: Speak gently and slowly with a warm, almost-whisper tone, like a kind elder calming a child before they take a first step.

function_reminder: Encourage the child partway through, noting they're doing this well.
text_draft: Ó dára! O ṣe dáadáa, keep it up! Ẹ̀kọ́ wa fẹ́rẹ̀ parí.
switch_points: Ó dára! O ṣe dáadáa, [[keep it up]]! Ẹ̀kọ́ wa fẹ́rẹ̀ parí.
register_note: Warm and celebratory, with a quick motivational nudge to carry the child cheerfully into the second half of the session.

function_reminder: Encourage the child before a noticeably harder item.
text_draft: Ó dára! Ìbéèrè tó ń bọ̀ yìí le díẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n mo gbádùn fún ọ!
switch_points: Ó dára! Ìbéèrè tó ń bọ̀ yìí le díẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n mo [[trust]] fún ọ!
register_note: Warm and upbeat, celebrating the child's effort so far while building confidence before a harder challenge — like a kind older sibling cheering them on.

function_reminder: Welcome the child back warmly after a pause in the session.
text_draft: Ẹ káàbọ̀ padà! Welcome back, jẹ́ ká tẹ̀síwájú papọ̀ nhẹ̀!
switch_points: Ẹ káàbọ̀ padà! [[Welcome back]], jẹ́ ká tẹ̀síwájú papọ̀ nhẹ̀!
register_note: Warm and bright, like a teacher clapping hands gently to signal a happy fresh start — no pressure, just joy at the child returning.

function_reminder: Gently ask the child to try speaking a little louder, encouragingly.
text_draft: Ẹ jẹ́ kí a gbọ́ ọ̀ ẹ! Sọ̀rọ̀ síi, speak up, ìwọ lè ṣe é!
switch_points: Ẹ jẹ́ kí a gbọ́ ọ̀ ẹ! Sọ̀rọ̀ síi, [[speak up]], ìwọ lè ṣe é!
register_note: Warm and playful, never scolding — frame it as an exciting invitation so the child feels safe to try again louder.

function_reminder: Gently bring the child's attention back without scolding.
text_draft: Ẹ wá, jẹ ká padà! Focus, ọmọ mi — a ń ṣe nǹkan tó dára!
switch_points: Ẹ wá, jẹ ká padà! [[Focus]], ọmọ mi — a ń ṣe nǹkan tó dára!
register_note: Warm and coaxing, not scolding — like a favourite auntie gently calling the child back to a fun game.

function_reminder: Close out a normal session and tell the child what happens next.
text_draft: Ó dára! Good job lónìí. Ìwé kíkà wa máa ń bá a lọ lọ́la!
switch_points: Ó dára! [[Good job]] lónìí. Ìwé kíkà wa máa ń bá a lọ lọ́la!
register_note: Warm and celebratory — end the session on a high note so the child looks forward to returning tomorrow.

function_reminder: Tell the child the session is being paused and can continue later.
text_draft: Dára, a ó tún padà wá. A lè tẹ̀síwájú lẹ́yìn náà, ọkàn mi!
switch_points: [[Dára]], a ó tún padà wá. A lè tẹ̀síwájú lẹ́yìn náà, ọkàn mi!
register_note: Keep the tone reassuring and affectionate so the child feels no anxiety about stopping mid-session.

function_reminder: Warmly end a session that's stopping earlier than planned.
text_draft: Ó dára, a máa padà wá ọjọ́ tó ń bọ̀. O ṣe àgbàdo, ọmọ mi!
switch_points: Ó dára, a máa padà wá ọjọ́ tó ń bọ̀. [[O ṣe àgbàdo]], ọmọ mi!
register_note: Warm and reassuring, making the child feel accomplished rather than disappointed that the session ended early.

function_reminder: Briefly tell the child what level they're working at, in simple terms.
text_draft: Ìwọ ń ṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa! Ìpele rẹ jẹ́ level one, ó dára gan-an!
switch_points: Ìwọ ń ṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa! Ìpele rẹ jẹ́ [[level one]], ó dára gan-an!
register_note: Keep the tone celebratory and affirming, so the child leaves the session feeling proud and motivated rather than assessed.

function_reminder: Thank the child for their effort today, warmly and briefly.
text_draft: Ẹ jẹ́ kí a dúpẹ́! O ṣe dára gan-an lónìí, well done!
switch_points: Ẹ jẹ́ kí a dúpẹ́! O ṣe dára gan-an lónìí, [[well done]]!
register_note: Keep the tone celebratory and heartfelt, like a proud teacher giving a warm send-off to a young child after a good lesson.

function_reminder: Tell the child when or how they'll practice again.
text_draft: Ó dàárọ̀! A ó padà wá ṣe àdáwọlé wa lọ́jọ́ tó ń bọ̀. Ó dára!
switch_points: Ó dàárọ̀! A ó padà wá ṣe àdáwọlé wa lọ́jọ́ tó ń bọ̀. [[Ó dára!]]
register_note: Keep the farewell bright and reassuring so the child looks forward to the next session rather than feeling the lesson is simply over.

function_reminder: Nothing was heard. Ask the child to try again.
text_draft: Hmm,미 mi ò gbọ́ ọ̀. Jọ̀wọ́ sọ lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i!
switch_points: Hmm, mi ò gbọ́ ọ̀. Jọ̀wọ́ sọ lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i!
register_note: Warm and encouraging, reassuring the child there is no wrong answer — just try speaking again.

function_reminder: Audio was too quiet. Ask the child to speak a little louder.
text_draft: Ẹ sọ lẹ́ẹ̀kan síi, sọ̀rọ̀ díẹ̀ louder!
switch_points: Ẹ sọ lẹ́ẹ̀kan síi, sọ̀rọ̀ díẹ̀ [[louder]]!
register_note: Warm and encouraging, gently nudging the child to raise their voice without sounding scolding.

function_reminder: Too much background noise. Ask the child to move somewhere quieter or closer to the phone.
text_draft: Ẹ jọ̀ọ́, wá sún mọ́ fóònù, ariwo púpọ̀ wà!
switch_points: Ẹ jọ̀ọ́, wá sún mọ́ [[fóònù]], ariwo púpọ̀ wà!
register_note: Warm and gently urgent, like a friendly nudge from a familiar adult, keeping the child at ease.

function_reminder: The answer was unclear. Ask the child to say it again.
text_draft: Ẹ jọ̀ọ́, sọ ìdáhùn rẹ mọ́ again.
switch_points: Ẹ jọ̀ọ́, sọ ìdáhùn rẹ mọ́ [[again]].
register_note: Warm and gentle, inviting the child to simply repeat without any sense of failure or pressure.

function_reminder: The child spoke while the agent was still talking. Ask them to wait for the agent to finish before answering.
text_draft: Dúró díẹ̀, jẹ́ kí n parí àsọ mi!
switch_points: Dúró díẹ̀, jẹ́ kí n parí àsọ mi!
register_note: Gently firm but warm, like a patient older sibling reminding a young child to take turns speaking.

function_reminder: Read a low-confidence answer back to the child to confirm it, instead of asking them to redo it.
text_draft: Ṣé o sọ pé "cat"? Ìyẹn ni ohun tó gbọ́ dáadáa.
switch_points: Ṣé o sọ pé [["cat"]]? Ìyẹn ni ohun tó gbọ́ dáadáa.
register_note: Warm and gently checking, not correcting — uses a soft yes/no question to echo what was heard without making the child feel wrong.

function_reminder: Alert the facilitator that repeated repair attempts have failed and their attention is needed now.
text_draft: Ẹ wọlé, ìgbìyànjú mẹ́ta ti kùnlẹ̀ lórí item yìí.
switch_points: Ẹ wọlé, ìgbìyànjú mẹ́ta ti kùnlẹ̀ lórí [[item]] yìí.
register_note: Neutral and direct adult-to-adult operational tone, conveying urgency without alarm.

function_reminder: Report a technical fault to the facilitator in plain, factual terms.
text_draft: Ìṣòro ẹ̀rọ wà. Session kò lè tẹ̀síwájú báyìí.
switch_points: Ìṣòro ẹ̀rọ wà. [[Session]] kò lè tẹ̀síwájú báyìí.
register_note: Neutral and factual, adult-to-adult operational register with no hedging or child-directed warmth.

function_reminder: Gently acknowledge that the child seems upset and say help is coming right away -- never try to continue the session first.
text_draft: Ó dára, màá bínú. Ẹni tó lè ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ ń bọ̀ ní báyìí.
switch_points: Ó dára, màá bínú. Ẹni tó lè ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ ń bọ̀ ní báyìí.
register_note: Soft and immediately reassuring, using simple Yoruba a young child knows instinctively, with no English switch needed here as the comfort words are most natural and warm in Yoruba alone.

function_reminder: Tell the child, simply and reassuringly, that a person is coming to help them now.
text_draft: Dúró, ènìyàn kan wá láti ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ now.
switch_points: Dúró, ènìyàn kan wá láti ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ [[now]].
register_note: Warm and calm reassurance aimed at a young child in a mildly stressful moment, keeping the language simple and soothing.

function_reminder: Ask the facilitator to confirm the assigned reading level before it takes effect.
text_draft: Jẹ́ kí a jẹrìí: a ti yàn ipele reading level kẹta. Ẹ fọwọ́ sí i?
switch_points: Jẹ́ kí a jẹrìí: a ti yàn ipele [[reading level]] kẹta. Ẹ fọwọ́ sí i?
register_note: Neutral and procedural, addressed to an adult facilitator seeking a binary confirmation before a system action is recorded.

function_reminder: Report a brief factual summary of the session's results to the facilitator.
text_draft: Ìjókòó yìí ti parí. Ọmọ náà pari ìdánwò mẹ́ta, ó ṣẹṣẹ kọ ọrọ mẹ́rin tuntun, score rẹ̀ jẹ́ ìdajì.
switch_points: Ìjókòó yìí ti parí. Ọmọ náà pari ìdánwò mẹ́ta, ó ṣẹṣẹ kọ ọrọ mẹ́rin tuntun, [[score]] rẹ̀ jẹ́ ìdajì.
register_note: Neutral and factual, adult-to-adult operational tone with no celebratory framing.

function_reminder: Prompt the facilitator to begin the next child's session.
text_draft: Ìpele yìí ti parí. Mú ọmọ tó kàn wá síbí.
switch_points: Ìpele yìí ti parí. Mú ọmọ tó kàn wá síbí.
register_note: Neutral and direct operational instruction addressed to the adult facilitator, with no child-directed warmth or enthusiasm.

function_reminder: Warn the facilitator that this session's recordings have not yet synced to the server.
text_draft: Ìgbàndè, àwọn gbàsilẹ̀ ìpínlẹ̀ yìí kò tíì sync sí server.
switch_points: Ìgbàndè, àwọn gbàsilẹ̀ ìpínlẹ̀ yìí kò tíì [[sync]] sí [[server]].
register_note: Neutral and factual, adult-to-adult operational tone with no warmth framing.
